mission_priority: XRP intelligence and measured prediction-engine mastery
foundation: Barrot V3 execution, verification, security and preservation

root_cause_findings.detail: Legacy scorer evaluated records at the first scheduled run after a 24-hour minimum, not at one fixed horizon. It compared an immutable emission reference with a mutable live CoinGecko price at check time, then rewrote history and summary.

Current main summary reports 1,697 checked, 772 correct and 45.5%. The current main signal_history.jsonl is 0 bytes, so the aggregate cannot be reproduced from row-level records in the current tree. The percentage is not a valid out-of-sample performance claim.
Barrot's system prompt described the legacy tracker as real directional correctness and injected checked/correct/accuracy_pct counts into its own context.

Landing page claimed order-book depth, live price structure, a pre-anchor filter, ternary BUY/SELL decisions and 1.58-bit logic. The emitter actually builds a news/LLM sentiment feature and has no order-book or technical-price input.
A valid JSON classifier response missing confidence previously defaulted to 0.5. Self-consistency output could also bypass the normal confidence clamp.
The sentiment-only emitter fetched a CoinGecko price and wrote price_at_emission into the feature history, allowing downstream code to mistake a sentiment timestamp reference for a forecast anchor.

proposed_controls: Replace the legacy scorer with deterministic blocked evaluation status; no network access and no file writes.
Make the scheduled/manual evaluation workflow contents:read, persist-credentials:false and artifact-only.
Remove the legacy accuracy percentage from the public API tool and daily digest.

Replace public web/signal_accuracy.json with a status-only response; preserve the old aggregate in web/legacy/signal_accuracy_unvalidated.json with an explicit unvalidated label and missing-row-level-history note.
Remove legacy accuracy injection and claims from scripts/ask_barrot.py; inject NOT_ISSUED and UNVALIDATED_VARIABLE_HORIZON instead.
Mark the XRP output as sentiment_feature_only, forecast_eligible=false and NOT_A_FORECAST.
Normalize labels to bullish/neutral/bearish; missing, invalid or nonfinite confidence becomes zero; clamp finite confidence to [0,1] and score to [0,100].
Remove the CoinGecko reference-price fetch and price_at_emission fields from newly emitted sentiment history rows.
Correct landing/subscriber copy so it describes only news/LLM sentiment, not order-book, technical analysis, BUY/SELL decisions or validated predictive performance.
Add explicit CI regression tests for the scorer, workflow, emitter, public API, daily digest, self-description and marketing claims.

preserved_legacy_metric.interpretation: Historical summary preserved for provenance only; cannot be independently reproduced from current-tree row-level history and is not an out-of-sample performance measure.

etf_flow_observations.detail: Five spot products in the tracked universe; one of five had reported. The reporting fund showed no creation/redemption; four funds remained unreported. Page displayed approximately $1.42B net assets and $1.81B cumulative net flows.

Page reports 12 products and approximately $1.49B AUM, 1.20B XRP and $23.89M daily volume, but its listed categories (6 spot, 4 derivative, 1 index) sum to 11. Its product universe and trading-volume measures are not comparable to the five-spot-product partial T+1 flow snapshot.
